title: Admin Web V2 Item Artwork Selection
problem: Admin Web V2 can inspect Media Items, but operators still lack an item-scoped Managed Artwork gallery and guarded Selected Artwork select/unpublish workflow.
gates: cd apps/admin-web && npm run generate:admin-api && npm run check && npm run test -- adminApi/client.test.ts
cd apps/admin-web && npm run check && npm run test -- App.test.tsx adminApi/client.test.ts adminApi/dataSource.test.ts
cd apps/admin-web && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build

evidence.summary: Opened the item artwork selection lane from GAR closeout and MBG follow-on order; initial inventory found backend/HTTP item artwork routes but missing generated Admin Web contract coverage.

Accepted backend item artwork gallery/select/unpublish routes for the first Admin Web artwork slice, documented redaction-safe fields and mutation fallback rules, and confirmed generated Admin Web contract coverage is the next prerequisite.

Added generated Admin Web contract route constants and DTOs for item artwork gallery/select/unpublish, regenerated the app-local contract, and added AdminApiClient methods plus tests for gallery GET, select POST, and unpublish DELETE.

Added the read-only /items/:itemId/artwork gallery route, Media Item detail entrypoint, safe AdminDataSource projection, deterministic fallback, and route/data-source redaction tests without posting select/unpublish mutations.
Added guarded select/replace and unpublish confirmation flows, live-only AdminDataSource mutation wrappers, redaction-safe result rendering, visible mutation failures, and no fake mutation fallback.

Ran full Admin Web check/test/build and Playwright CLI browser smoke for item detail, artwork gallery, select confirmation, unpublish confirmation, desktop/mobile overflow, console errors, and unsafe artwork text exclusions.

Closed the lane after review and fresh closeout verification: Admin Web check/test/build, focused nako-api admin contract tests, cargo fmt, git diff --check, and AWA-060 browser smoke reuse because closeout changed only docs.

continue_policy.notes: Open admin-web-v2-catalog-repair-actions next if continuing the MBG media-governance follow-on sequence. Pull settings mutation or users/permissions/Library Access forward only if product priority changes.
